name: PricingCalculator
description: Interactive duration × workload pricing calculator for the pricing page.
dense: Pricing calculator section: duration and workload SelectableCard groups drive a live summary (allocation, hours, effective rate, total investment) with a booking CTA.

usage.description: PricingCalculator is the custom-engagement estimator on the pricing page: two single-select SelectableCardGroups (duration: 2 weeks to 12 months; workload: up to 2-5 days/week, with short 2-week/1-month engagements offering only 4-5 days) recompute total hours, allocation, the effective hourly rate, and the total investment on every change (partnership selections add a '4th day is free' note). Only the 6/12-month partnership tiers at 4+ days/week earn the 90 EUR/h partnership rate; those selections carry Partnership badges and a distinct discounted price-card treatment. It complements the fixed packages; it does not replace them.

bestPractices.description: Keep the pricing model in pricingMath.ts as the single source of truth; the component only renders its output.
Don't use it for fixed-scope package pricing; that's the packages section of PricingPageContent.
Don't hardcode currency formatting; totals format via Intl.NumberFormat on the active language.

ariaRequirements: section labelled by the calculator title
native fieldset/legend + radio semantics from SelectableCardGroup
CTA is a real link to /contact
visually hidden role=status region announces recomputed totals and the workload clamp
workload radios are added/removed on duration change; selection is clamped programmatically and focus is restored if the focused radio unmounts
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-18 — Initial beta: native radio groups via SelectableCardGroup (keyboard + AT from the platform), axe assertion in unit tests, ForcedColors story added.

forbiddenUse: duplicate the pricing model outside pricingMath.ts
